ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a marine food web, labeled with plankton (plankton) at the lower right, squid (squid) at the lower left, fish (fish) on the right side, dolphins (dolphins) on the left side, and seabirds (seabirds) at the top. The arrows show energy flowing from the organisms being eaten to the predators; an arrow from plankton to squid can be seen, and there is also a connection between plankton and fish. Reasoning: If plankton die, the populations that directly rely on plankton to obtain energy will be affected first and most obviously. In the figure, the energy source of squid comes directly from plankton, so the disappearance of plankton will most affect the energy supply of squid.
